upstream_sync.policy: maintained fork of JimLiu/baoyu-skills; main is a pure upstream mirror (12h sync via .github/workflows/sync-upstream.yml), the fastagent branch carries the package shell and adaptation

intent.description: Baoyu Skills 合集——宝玉（Jim Liu）的 21 个 Claude 内容技能整仓路由到一个根 SKILL.md：翻译/精翻（translate）、发布公众号/微博/X（publish）、URL 或 X 推文转 Markdown、YouTube 字幕下载、微信群聊精华总结、文章配图/封面图/信息图/知识漫画/小红书图片/幻灯片 生成、图片压缩、Markdown 格式化与转 HTML、SVG 图表（架构图/流程图）、Electron 应用反编译、AI 图像生成（多后端）。对"翻译这篇文章"、"把网页转成 markdown"、"发公众号/微博/X"、"下载 YouTube 字幕"、"总结群聊"、"给文章配图/生成封面/信息图/漫画/小红书图片/幻灯片"、"画架构图/流程图"、"压缩图片"、"格式化 markdown"、"md 转 html"、"提取 Electron 应用源码"、"生成图片"等意图触发。
intent.job_to_be_done: 把宝玉的 21 个内容技能整仓打包为 fastagent 单框架 skill：一个根 SKILL.md 路由到对应子技能（翻译/发布/转换/抓取/社群总结/图像生成/图表/反编译），子技能本体在 {baseDir}/skills/<name>/SKILL.example.md 完整读后执行
exclusions: 单次翻译/单次总结不是本包职责（子技能各有完整工作流，根路由只负责选技能）
投资建议（本包是内容工具）

defaults.attribution: Original skills by Jim Liu (宝玉) / baoyu-skills

把这篇 markdown 发布到公众号
把这篇 markdown 发布到微博
把这篇 markdown 发布到 X
把这个网页转成 markdown
把这条 X 推文转成 markdown
下载这个 YouTube 视频的字幕
把微信群聊精华整理成 markdown 摘要
给这篇 markdown 文章配图
给这篇 markdown 文章生成封面图
把这份数据做成信息图并附 markdown 说明
画一个知识漫画，输出 markdown 分镜
生成小红书种草图片和 markdown 文案
把这份 markdown 做成幻灯片
下载并压缩这些图片

帮我润色一下这段文字

router_rules: 读根 SKILL.md 路由表，按用户意图选子技能；拿不准先问用户
先完整读 {baseDir}/skills/<name>/SKILL.example.md 再执行，不凭技能名猜流程
compact_workflow: 路由 → 读子技能 SKILL.example.md → 检查 EXTEND.md 偏好（缺且需 first-time setup 则 BLOCKING 询问）→ 按子技能工作流执行（脚本走 ${BUN_X} {baseDir}/skills/<name>/scripts/…）→ 输出落盘到该技能约定目录
output_contract: 输出写入各子技能约定目录（translate/、posts/、cover-image/、diagram/、youtube-transcript/ 等），不全在对话里展示

trust.remote_metadata_policy: allow read-only public content; forbid uploading user chats or posts without consent

permissions.network: HTTPS fetch for url-to-markdown / youtube-transcript / x-to-markdown; publishing to WeChat/Weibo/X only with user-confirmed content
permissions.file_write: skill output dirs only (translate/, posts/, cover-image/, diagram/, youtube-transcript/, …); EXTEND.md preference files; never modify user config outside .baoyu-skills/
permissions.subprocess: bun for the bundled skill scripts (scripts/*.ts); no arbitrary code execution
permissions.interactive: first-time EXTEND.md setup; publishing confirmation; image backend selection; consent for reverse-engineered X API

scaffold: SKILL.md frontmatter with name and description
README hook and natural trigger examples
clear exclusions (one-off summaries/translations are not this package's job alone)
production: install and README verification (npx skills add and git clone paths)
root-only discoverable SKILL.md entrypoint (nested skills stored as SKILL.example.md)
library: trust boundary (local content read-only; publishing gated on user confirmation)
governed: secret scan (no API keys / tokens committed)
rollback boundary (scripts never modify user config or holdings)
public claim guard (validation and trigger claims match tests)
README, MIT LICENSE, and install evidence verified

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
